free.a: Yes. Every tool and feature is free for everyone. There are no paid plans and no watermarks. Generous fair-use limits keep the service fast for all.

account.a: No. An account is optional and only adds conveniences like history, API keys, longer file retention and access across devices.

retention.q: How long do you keep my files?
retention.a: Files are deleted automatically one hour after processing. Signed-in users can choose 24 hours instead. You can always delete instantly.

safe.q: Is it safe for confidential documents?
safe.a: Files are encrypted at rest with AES-256, processed in isolated sandboxes and never inspected by people or written to logs.

limits.a: Only fair-use limits that protect the servers: up to 200 MB per file, 100 files per task, and hourly and daily task caps that normal use never reaches.

interrupted.q: What if my upload is interrupted?
interrupted.a: Uploads are resumable. When your connection returns, the upload continues from where it stopped.
